title: Moss Overpass
description: Four softly spaced notes cross three slower steps. After eight bars the hands exchange those rhythms and the opening melody moves into the bass; a wider return finally settles on B minor, leaving the home key of E minor behind.
technical_note: The first seven bars set four dotted quarters against three half notes. At bar nine the hands exchange these patterns. Keep both pulses even and the melodic hand slightly forward; no acceleration is implied by the shorter note values.

performance.note: The two pulses remain supple but distinct. Lean into the answering left-hand phrase, then let the chordal return broaden towards a B-minor close.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
